story.text: 저녁 늦게 도착한 노래방은 알록달록한 네온사인이 반짝이고 있었다. 용우가 익숙하게 방 번호를 받아들며 앞장섰다.
story.reading: jeo-nyeok neuj-ge do-chak-han no-rae-bang-eun al-lok-dal-lok-han ne-on-sa-in-i ban-jjag-i-go iss-eot-da. yong-u-ga ig-suk-ha-ge bang beon-ho-reul bad-a-deul-myeo ap-jang-seot-da.
story.en: The karaoke place we reached late in the evening had colorful neon signs flickering outside. Yongwoo took the room number like it was second nature and led the way in.

story.text: 작은 방에 자리를 잡자마자 용우가 리모컨을 집어 들었다. '예약곡 순서 안 지키면 재미없다. 규칙은 지켜야지.'
story.reading: jag-eun bang-e ja-ri-reul jap-ja-ma-ja yong-u-ga ri-mo-keon-eul jib-eo deul-eot-da. ye-yak-gok sun-seo an ji-ki-myeon jae-mi-eop-da. gyu-chig-eun ji-kyeo-ya-ji.
story.en: The moment we settled into the small room, Yongwoo picked up the remote. 'It's no fun if you don't stick to the queued order. Rules are rules.'

story.text: 내가 장난삼아 음치 흉내를 내며 첫 곡을 망치자, 용우가 어이없다는 듯 웃음을 터뜨렸다. '와, 이 정도면 진짜 음치 아이가.'
story.reading: nae-ga jang-nan-sam-a eum-chi hyung-nae-reul nae-myeo cheot gog-eul mang-chi-ja, yong-u-ga eo-i-eob-da-neun deut us-eum-eul teo-tteu-ryeot-da. wa, i jeong-do-myeon jin-jja eum-chi a-i-ga.
story.en: I ruined the first song, jokingly pretending to be tone-deaf, and Yongwoo burst out laughing in disbelief. 'Wow, at this point you might be an actual tone-deaf person.'

story.text: 다음은 용우 차례였다. 마이크를 잡은 그가 낮은 목소리로 노래를 시작하자, 예상 밖의 감미로운 저음에 나도 모르게 조용해졌다.
story.reading: da-eum-eun yong-u cha-rye-yeot-da. ma-i-keu-reul jab-eun geu-ga naj-eun mok-so-ri-ro no-rae-reul si-jak-ha-ja, ye-sang bakk-ui gam-mi-ro-un jeo-eum-e na-do mo-reu-ge jo-yong-hae-jyeot-da.
story.en: Next was Yongwoo's turn. As he grabbed the mic and began singing in a low voice, I fell quiet without meaning to, caught off guard by his unexpectedly sweet low register.

story.text: 고음 부분에서마저 흔들림 없이 열창하는 모습에 박수가 절로 나왔다. '기내 방송할 때보다 더 멋있는데?' 용우가 은근히 어깨를 으쓱였다.
story.reading: go-eum bu-bun-e-seo-ma-jeo heun-deul-lim eop-si yeol-chang-ha-neun mo-seub-e bak-su-ga jeol-lo na-wat-da. gi-nae bang-song-hal ttae-bo-da deo meos-it-neun-de? yong-u-ga eun-geun-hi eo-kkae-reul eu-sseug-yeot-da.
story.en: Even on the high notes, he sang his heart out without wavering, and I found myself clapping without thinking. 'Better-looking than during your in-flight announcements?' Yongwoo gave a quietly satisfied shrug.

story.text: '점수 확인해봐라.' 화면에 뜬 100점에 가까운 숫자를 보며 용우가 승부욕 가득한 눈빛으로 나를 쳐다봤다. '니 차례다. 이번엔 제대로 불러봐라.'
story.reading: jeom-su hwag-in-hae-bwa-ra. hwa-myeon-e tteun baeg-jeom-e ga-kka-un sut-ja-reul bo-myeo yong-u-ga seung-bu-yok ga-deuk-han nun-bit-eu-ro na-reul chyeo-da-bwat-da. ni cha-rye-da. i-beon-en je-dae-ro bul-leo-bwa-ra.
story.en: 'Check the score.' Looking at the number on screen, close to a perfect hundred, Yongwoo stared at me with eyes full of competitive fire. 'Your turn. Sing it properly this time.'

story.text: 마지막 곡은 함께 부르기로 했다. 엇박자로 웃음이 터지면서도, 마이크 너머로 맞잡은 하모니가 꽤 그럴듯했다. 노래방을 나설 때는 목이 다 쉬어 있었다.
story.reading: ma-ji-mak gog-eun ham-kke bu-reu-gi-ro haet-da. eot-bak-ja-ro us-eum-i teo-ji-myeon-seo-do, ma-i-keu neo-meo-ro maj-jab-eun ha-mo-ni-ga kkwae geu-reol-deu-taet-da. no-rae-bang-eul na-seol ttae-neun mog-i da swi-eo iss-eot-da.
story.en: For the last song, we decided to sing together. We kept bursting into laughter over our mismatched timing, but the harmony we found through the mic sounded pretty decent. By the time we left, our voices were completely hoarse.

words.example_en: My reserved song finally came up.

words.meaning: a tone-deaf person, someone who can't sing in tune
a low tone, deep register (of voice)
words.example_en: His deep, low voice was charming.

words.meaning: to sing passionately, to sing one's heart out
words.example_en: The singer sang their heart out on stage.
He tends to have a strong competitive streak.

sentences.ko: 용우는 예약곡 순서를 꼭 지키자고 했다.
sentences.reading: yong-u-neun ye-yak-gok sun-seo-reul kkok ji-ki-ja-go haet-da
sentences.en: Yongwoo insisted on sticking to the queued song order.
I jokingly pretended to be tone-deaf.
His low voice was far sweeter than I expected.
He sang his heart out all the way through the high notes without faltering.
Seeing the score, his competitive spirit flared up.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 예약곡 순서 안 지키면 재미없다. 규칙은 지켜야지.
turns.reading: ye-yak-gok sun-seo an ji-ki-myeon jae-mi-eop-da. gyu-chig-eun ji-kyeo-ya-ji.
turns.en: It's no fun if you don't stick to the queued order. Rules are rules.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 노래방에 무슨 규칙이야, 그냥 노는 건데.
turns.reading: no-rae-bang-e mu-seun gyu-chig-i-ya, geu-nyang no-neun geon-de.
turns.en: Since when does karaoke have rules, we're just here to have fun.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 그래도 순서는 지켜야 다 같이 재밌지. 자, 니 차례다.
turns.reading: geu-rae-do sun-seo-neun ji-kyeo-ya da gat-i jae-mit-ji. ja, ni cha-rye-da.
turns.en: Still, sticking to the order means it's fun for everyone. Come on, your turn.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.reading: na sa-sil eum-chi-ya. mi-ri mal-hae-du-neun geo-ya.
turns.en: ...I'm actually tone-deaf, just so you know in advance.

dialogues.question: 용우가 예약곡 순서를 지키자고 고집하는 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo insists on keeping the song order?
dialogues.correct_answer: 다 같이 공평하게 즐기길 바라는 마음에서다
options: 다 같이 공평하게 즐기길 바라는 마음에서다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 다 같이 공평하게 즐길 수 있도록 순서를 지키자고 말하는 것으로, 그의 배려심이 드러납니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 너 노래 왜 이렇게 잘해? 완전 딴사람 같아.
turns.reading: neo no-rae wae i-reo-ke jal-hae? wan-jeon ttan-sa-ram gat-a.
turns.en: Why are you so good at singing? You seem like a totally different person.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.reading: gi-nae bang-song-i chwi-mi-ro bal-jeon-han geo-da, geu-nyang.
turns.en: ...It's just, in-flight announcements turned into a hobby, that's all.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Don't make excuses, you're basically a professional singer.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 됐고, 점수나 확인해봐라. 니 차례 오기 전에.
turns.reading: dwaet-go, jeom-su-na hwag-in-hae-bwa-ra. ni cha-rye o-gi jeon-e.
turns.en: Whatever, just check the score. Before your turn comes up.

dialogues.question: 칭찬을 들은 용우의 반응으로 가장 알맞은 설명은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's reaction to being praised?
dialogues.correct_answer: 쑥스러워하며 대수롭지 않은 척 화제를 돌린다
options: 쑥스러워하며 대수롭지 않은 척 화제를 돌린다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 칭찬에 쑥스러워하며 대수롭지 않은 척 화제를 돌리는 전형적인 츤데레 반응을 보였습니다.
